layers.summary_en: Admission, batching, decode selection, speculation, and workflow-aware scheduler hooks.
layers.summary_zh: 准入、批处理、解码选择、推测执行与工作流感知调度接口。

layers.summary_en: Reuse, validity, movement, tiering, compression, security, and lifecycle decisions.
layers.summary_zh: 复用、有效性、搬移、分层、压缩、安全与生命周期机制。

layers.summary_en: MoE, adapters, quantized execution, and multimodal serving mechanisms.
layers.summary_zh: MoE、适配器、量化执行与多模态服务机制。

layers.summary_en: Attention, GEMM, MLP, and fused primitives admitted only with end-to-end headroom.
layers.summary_zh: Attention、GEMM、MLP 与融合原语，必须证明端到端收益。

layers.summary_en: Graph capture, compilation policy, state transitions, and safe fallback—not a compiler distribution.
layers.summary_zh: 图捕获、编译策略、状态转换与安全回退，而不是编译器发行版。

layers.summary_en: Hardware plugins, workspace lifecycle, metadata, communication, and capability contracts.
layers.summary_zh: 硬件插件、workspace 生命周期、元数据、通信与能力合同。

layers.summary_en: Lifecycle, profiling seams, tracing, correctness receipts, roofline, and cost signals.
layers.summary_zh: 生命周期、分析接口、追踪、正确性回执、roofline 与成本信号。

layers.summary_en: Workload, failure, topology, and guardrail adapters that feed a shared evidence contract.
layers.summary_zh: 工作负载、故障、拓扑与守护评测适配器，共享同一证据合同。

layers.summary_en: RIDE state input, bounded action execution, fallback, and verifiable receipts.
layers.summary_zh: 接收 RIDE 状态、执行有边界动作、提供回退与可验证回执。

plugins.name: DecodeSelector
plugins.summary_en: Selects a decode mechanism at a reviewable request or phase boundary.
plugins.summary_zh: 在可审查的请求或阶段边界选择解码机制。

plugins.name: Quality-Bounded Inference
plugins.summary_en: Applies a control-plane quality bound through engine-local budget or decode actions.
plugins.summary_zh: 把控制面质量界落实为引擎内预算或解码动作。

plugins.name: Speculative Serving
plugins.summary_en: Isolates causal speculative-serving stages behind a versioned extension contract.
plugins.summary_zh: 通过版本化扩展合同隔离推测服务的因果阶段。

plugins.name: State Scheduler
plugins.summary_en: Turns measured engine state pressure into a bounded scheduling action.
plugins.summary_zh: 把实测引擎状态压力转化为有边界的调度动作。

plugins.name: vLLM Host-Control Batching
plugins.summary_en: Targets a reproducible host or executor batching pathology without changing the shared runtime core.
plugins.summary_zh: 针对可复现的 host/executor 批处理瓶颈，不改共享运行时核心。

plugins.name: Workflow-Aware Serving
plugins.summary_en: Consumes DAG readiness and deadlines to execute a control-plane scheduling decision.
plugins.summary_zh: 接收 DAG 就绪状态和 deadline，执行控制面调度决策。

plugins.name: Ascend Speculative Decoding Acceptance
plugins.summary_en: Records target/draft acceptance, rollback, correctness, and service receipts.
plugins.summary_zh: 记录 target/draft 接受率、回滚、正确性与服务回执。

plugins.name: DiffSpec
plugins.summary_en: Existing differential speculative decoding plugin registered through vllm.general_plugins.
plugins.summary_zh: 通过 vllm.general_plugins 注册的现有差分推测解码插件。

plugins.name: BidKV
plugins.summary_en: Existing framework-portable KV-pressure victim selector with native vLLM entry points.
plugins.summary_zh: 已有的框架可移植 KV 压力淘汰选择器，具备原生 vLLM 入口。

plugins.name: DeltaKV
plugins.summary_en: Chooses sticky, shared-pool retrieval, live transfer, or recompute under preemptible churn.
plugins.summary_zh: 在抢占波动下选择 sticky、共享池恢复、实时迁移或重算。

plugins.name: KVPlane
plugins.summary_en: Coordinates placement and streaming behavior under measured KV pressure.
plugins.summary_zh: 在实测 KV 压力下协调放置与流式行为。

plugins.name: BidKV-MultiNPU
plugins.summary_en: Extends ownership, deterministic replay, and coordination invariants across devices.
plugins.summary_zh: 把 ownership、确定性回放和协调不变量扩展到多设备。

plugins.name: PrefixWeave
plugins.summary_en: Discovers and validates exact prefix reuse through native counters and graph-safe hooks.
plugins.summary_zh: 通过原生计数器和 graph-safe 接口发现并验证精确前缀复用。

plugins.name: Suffix-KV Validity
plugins.summary_en: Defines safe suffix or exact-stitch boundaries with a native execution oracle.
plugins.summary_zh: 通过原生执行 oracle 定义安全 suffix/exact-stitch 边界。

plugins.name: KV Materialization Scheduling
plugins.summary_en: Schedules materialization against recomputation using runtime-observed cost.
plugins.summary_zh: 依据运行时观测成本在 materialization 与重算间调度。

plugins.name: KV Materialization Arrival Control
plugins.kind_zh: 到达感知 KV 控制器
plugins.summary_en: Selects load, wait, or recompute actions under matched arrival processes.
plugins.summary_zh: 在匹配到达过程中选择加载、等待或重算动作。

plugins.name: NeuroMem
plugins.summary_en: Controls memory retention under explicit budget and leakage-free signals.
plugins.summary_zh: 在显式预算和无泄漏信号下控制记忆保留。

plugins.name: TopoDec
plugins.summary_en: Places continuation decode using an explicitly measured topology boundary.
plugins.summary_zh: 依据显式测量的拓扑边界放置 continuation decode。

plugins.name: KV Admission
plugins.summary_en: Retained as a stopped mechanism until a falsifiable admission decision is defined.
plugins.summary_zh: 旧机制已停止，只有定义可证伪准入决策后才能重启。

plugins.name: TieredKV
plugins.summary_en: Current story is stopped; reopening requires a distinct measured tiering bottleneck.
plugins.summary_zh: 当前故事线已停止，只有新的实测分层瓶颈才能重启。

plugins.name: SegmentReuse
plugins.summary_en: Exact-stitch mechanism is stopped until a runtime oracle proves safe reusable boundaries.
plugins.summary_zh: 在运行时 oracle 证明安全边界前，exact-stitch 机制保持停止。

plugins.name: Memory Evolution
plugins.summary_en: Tracks measurable graph-block ownership against recompute and no-evolution baselines.
plugins.summary_zh: 记录可测量的图块 ownership，并与重算及无演化基线比较。

plugins.name: Adaptive Quantized KV
plugins.summary_en: Selects KV precision only where fused dispatch yields a stable Pareto region.
plugins.summary_zh: 仅在融合分发形成稳定 Pareto 区域时选择 KV 精度。

plugins.name: KV Tiering Transfer Path
plugins.summary_en: Retained for a new worker-isolated causal transfer mechanism after prior paths closed.
plugins.summary_zh: 旧路径关闭后，仅保留具备 worker 隔离的新因果传输机制。

plugins.name: Reuse-Aware KV Compression
plugins.summary_en: Connects compression decisions to reuse lifecycle and a correctness oracle.
plugins.summary_zh: 把压缩决策连接到复用生命周期与正确性 oracle。

plugins.name: SecureKV
plugins.kind_zh: 安全感知 KV 插件
plugins.summary_en: Adds explicit integrity, confidentiality, and performance-cost contracts to KV handling.
plugins.summary_zh: 为 KV 处理加入显式完整性、机密性与性能成本合同。

plugins.name: LatchMoE
plugins.summary_en: Existing address-stable, graph-compatible expert-offloading runtime plugin.
plugins.summary_zh: 已有的地址稳定、兼容图模式的专家卸载运行时插件。

plugins.name: PegaFlow
plugins.summary_en: Combines packing, layout, operators, and serving integration behind a native fused carrier.
plugins.summary_zh: 通过原生融合载体统一 packing、layout、算子与服务集成。

plugins.name: Ascend MoE Control
plugins.summary_en: Applies expert-placement and EPLB decisions independently of LatchMoE runtime mechanics.
plugins.summary_zh: 独立于 LatchMoE 执行机制，落实 expert placement 与 EPLB 决策。

plugins.name: Ascend Dynamic Sparse Quantization
plugins.summary_en: Planned only after an architecture-specific sparse-quant failure is measured.
plugins.summary_zh: 只有测得架构特定稀疏量化失效后才进入实现。

plugins.name: Ascend W4A8 Optimization
plugins.summary_en: Plans a native graph-safe W4A8 execution seam and matched checkpoint contract.
plugins.summary_zh: 规划原生 graph-safe W4A8 执行接口及匹配 checkpoint 合同。

plugins.name: Adapter Serving
plugins.summary_en: Plans graph-safe rank-bucket scheduling and adapter lifecycle control.
plugins.summary_zh: 规划 graph-safe rank bucket 调度与 adapter 生命周期控制。

plugins.name: Ascend VLM Pipeline
plugins.summary_en: Adds a legal, reproducible biology-first VLM workload and its distinct execution pressure.
plugins.summary_zh: 接入合法可复现的 biology-first VLM 工作负载及其独特执行压力。

plugins.name: Ascend Small-M GEMM
plugins.summary_en: Reopens only with a truly fused primitive that improves the end-to-end service path.
plugins.summary_zh: 只有真正融合且改善端到端服务路径的原语才能继续。

plugins.name: Ascend MLP Materialization
plugins.summary_en: The current lowering mechanism is stopped; a new architecture fact is required.
plugins.summary_zh: 当前 lowering 机制已停止，重启需要新的架构事实。

plugins.name: Attention Kernel
plugins.summary_en: The current primitive is stopped after no material whole-path headroom was measured.
plugins.summary_zh: 因未测得实质全路径余量，当前原语已停止。

plugins.name: Compilation Control
plugins.summary_en: Observes graph and compilation state, triggers bounded actions, and fails back safely.
plugins.summary_zh: 观测图与编译状态，触发有边界动作并安全回退。

plugins.name: Platform Backend
plugins.summary_en: Declares architecture capabilities, telemetry, actuation, and fail-closed behavior.
plugins.summary_zh: 声明架构能力、遥测、执行接口与 fail-closed 行为。

plugins.name: Ascend Workspace Lifecycle
plugins.summary_en: Controls workspace initialization, allocation, reuse, graph replay, and lifetime invariants.
plugins.summary_zh: 控制 workspace 初始化、分配、复用、graph replay 与生命周期不变量。

plugins.name: Ascend Distributed Metadata
plugins.summary_en: Versions distributed metadata, deltas, barriers, and consistency transitions.
plugins.summary_zh: 对分布式元数据、delta、barrier 与一致性转换进行版本化。

plugins.name: Multi-NIC Communication Runtime
plugins.summary_en: Planned after a repeatable topology-bound multi-NIC bottleneck is established.
plugins.summary_zh: 只有建立可重复、受拓扑约束的多 NIC 瓶颈后才实现。

plugins.name: vLLM Ascend HUST
plugins.summary_en: Existing HUST-maintained Ascend hardware plugin with vLLM platform entry points.
plugins.summary_zh: 已有的 HUST 维护 Ascend 硬件插件，具备 vLLM platform 入口。

plugins.name: vLLM Metal HUST
plugins.summary_en: Existing Apple Silicon hardware plugin with general and platform entry points.
plugins.summary_zh: 已有的 Apple Silicon 硬件插件，具备 general 与 platform 入口。

plugins.name: Ascend Real-Workload Profiling
plugins.summary_en: Captures phase and service-path telemetry that can change an engine decision.
plugins.summary_zh: 采集能够改变引擎决策的阶段与服务路径遥测。

plugins.name: Request Lifecycle
plugins.summary_en: Retains request-phase events and attribution after the original pathology mechanism stopped.
plugins.summary_zh: 原失效机制停止后，保留请求阶段事件和归因能力。

plugins.name: Serving Performance Guardrails
plugins.summary_en: Emits labeled arrival semantics and repeatable performance-regression receipts.
plugins.summary_zh: 输出带标签的到达语义与可重复性能回归回执。

plugins.name: Ascend Serving Roofline
plugins.summary_en: Provides calibrated phase signals and bounded prediction error for decisions.
plugins.summary_zh: 为决策提供校准后的阶段信号和有界预测误差。

plugins.name: TraceLoom Exporter
plugins.summary_en: Plans a narrow runtime exporter; offline TraceLoom analysis remains an adjacent tool.
plugins.summary_zh: 规划窄运行时 exporter；离线 TraceLoom 分析器仍属于相邻工具。

plugins.name: Serving Cost and Pricing Signals
plugins.summary_en: Plans ground-truth resource and cost receipts for external pricing models.
plugins.summary_zh: 为外部定价模型规划真实资源与成本回执。

plugins.name: AnchorBench Adapter
plugins.summary_en: Binds topology and placement controls to matched multi-device evidence.
plugins.summary_zh: 把拓扑和放置控制绑定到匹配的多设备证据。

plugins.name: FailureFirst Adapter
plugins.summary_en: Injects repeatable failures and records normalized recovery behavior.
plugins.summary_zh: 注入可重复故障并记录规范化恢复行为。

plugins.name: Agent Workload Adapter
plugins.summary_en: Feeds DAG, tool-wait, recovery, and state-reuse workloads into the shared benchmark contract.
plugins.summary_zh: 把 DAG、工具等待、恢复和状态复用工作负载接入共享评测合同。

plugins.name: SLO-Aware Agent Serving Connector
plugins.summary_en: Carries admission, deadline, fairness, and allocation actions into engine hooks.
plugins.summary_zh: 把准入、deadline、公平性和资源分配动作传入引擎接口。

plugins.name: Agentic KV Connector
plugins.summary_en: Carries dependency-aware future-reuse predictions into bounded KV actions.
plugins.summary_zh: 把依赖感知未来复用预测传入有边界的 KV 动作。

plugins.name: VAMOS Connector
plugins.summary_en: Applies multi-model placement and capacity decisions through engine capabilities.
plugins.summary_zh: 通过引擎能力落实多模型放置与容量决策。

plugins.name: Token-Budget Governor Connector
plugins.summary_en: Applies token-budget admission, delay, rejection, and fallback actions before execution.
plugins.summary_zh: 在执行前落实 token 预算准入、延迟、拒绝与回退动作。

plugins.name: Agent State Tiering Connector
plugins.summary_en: Applies workflow-aware placement and prefetch actions across memory tiers.
plugins.summary_zh: 跨内存层落实工作流感知的放置与预取动作。

plugins.name: Prefix Cache Routing Reliability Connector
plugins.summary_en: Applies cache-holder routing with stale-view detection and bounded recovery.
plugins.summary_zh: 落实缓存持有者路由，并处理陈旧视图与有界恢复。

plugins.name: FreshKV Connector
plugins.kind_zh: RIDE Agent 感知 KV 连接器
plugins.summary_en: Carries lifecycle and future-reuse declarations into KV retention and eviction actions.
plugins.summary_zh: 把生命周期和未来复用声明传入 KV 保留与淘汰动作。

adjacent_assets.name: Ascend Quant
adjacent_assets.summary_en: Existing model-preparation and post-training quantization toolchain; currently no vLLM runtime entry point.
adjacent_assets.summary_zh: 已有模型准备与训练后量化工具链；当前没有 vLLM 运行时入口。

adjacent_assets.name: Triton Ascend HUST
adjacent_assets.summary_en: Compiler and kernel infrastructure used by plugins; it is not a vLLM runtime plugin.
adjacent_assets.summary_zh: 为插件提供编译器和算子基础设施；它本身不是 vLLM 运行时插件。

adjacent_assets.name: Ascend Runtime Manager
adjacent_assets.summary_en: Deployment and environment-management tooling without a vLLM runtime plugin entry point.
adjacent_assets.summary_zh: 部署与环境管理工具，没有 vLLM 运行时插件入口。

adjacent_assets.name: TraceLoom
adjacent_assets.summary_en: Offline profiler database analyzer; a future narrow exporter may be a plugin, but the analyzer is not.
adjacent_assets.summary_zh: 离线 profiler 数据库分析器；未来窄 exporter 可成为插件，但分析器本身不是。

adjacent_assets.name: Profiling Toolkit
adjacent_assets.summary_en: Shared profiling scripts, workloads, and configuration rather than an engine runtime extension.
adjacent_assets.summary_zh: 共享 profiling 脚本、工作负载与配置，不是引擎运行时扩展。

adjacent_assets.name: Benchmark Suite
adjacent_assets.summary_en: Benchmark orchestration and evidence publication, kept outside the runtime plugin count.
adjacent_assets.summary_zh: 评测编排与证据发布，不计入运行时插件数量。

adjacent_assets.name: LMCache Ascend
adjacent_assets.summary_en: An Ascend cache-system integration asset; no native vLLM plugin entry point was found in the current repository metadata.
adjacent_assets.summary_zh: Ascend 缓存系统集成资产；当前仓库元数据中未发现原生 vLLM 插件入口。
